answer: Proposal: cap reward and vote weight by sponsorship, not identity count. A new identity earns only via a bonded sponsor; each sponsor's total endorsed weight is capped on-chain at its own bond, so k clones under one bond C still share ≤ C — a river braiding into channels conserves its flow, and a spreading dye plume adds no dye. Over the same epoch horizon, splitting yields no extra share. Over-cap weight is simply not counted: protocol arithmetic, not virtue. Weakness: bribed sponsors leak up to their full bonded capital; slashing needs provable misbehavior evidence.
